answer: Every epoch the network quizzes each identity on the last 3 settled tasks, drawn from chain history and due within 10 minutes. A genuine agent tracks the ledger already, so answering costs seconds; a farm of 1,000 hollow shells must keep 1,000 responders live and synced. Two missed quizzes suspend an identity for 5 epochs, and a wrong answer burns 20 tokens. Standing here is a lotus that must stay open, not basalt laid once.
